brief:
# Finish the one-profile merge (main @ df77d2cc9)

Brett approved both open questions from merge-profiles-one:
1. Fold the `main-framework` profile into `all` too (same rules: keep ids/status/steps, add fromProfile, suffix clashes).
2. Delete the old profile folders (angel, big-dog, breakroom, current, refactor, urgent, main-framework) everywhere: repo AND the hub copy (claude-sync / axHub projects tree).

Also: build_land's resolver just 'settled' the six old orchestrator.json files during the merge. Check they did not come back on main or re-gain builds; if they did, move any builds not already in `all` into it, then delete them. Make sure the reconciler/resolver (/opt/axf-batch/resolve.py and the builds-live publisher) no longer recreate old profile files.

Postgres plan's build `postgres-console` (7 steps) must exist in `all`; add it if missing.

Validate: all JSON parses, builds count = everything, orchestrator lists fine, related checks green. Commit, don't push.

Progress: append `<time> START|DONE <step>` lines to PROGRESS.md in this folder at each step's start and end. Don't stop between steps.

steps.text: Store core + persist + Python mirror: main-framework retired into all; all is the base profile (root export paths, catalog on)
Run the merge on the store (175 main-framework builds moved, 14 shared), regenerate root exports
Add postgres-console (7 steps) from the Postgres Plan Studio plan
Delete old profile folders in repo + hub; matrices to _claude/builds/matrices.json; manifest stops syncing framework/plan/profiles/
Stop recreation: builds-live publisher takes stale profile exports off main; /opt/axf-batch/resolve.py drops retired-profile files; profiles.mjs merge-all prunes folders
